title: Uniform statewide procedures.
bodyText: The agency shall adopt uniform statewide procedures in compliance with applicable federal law, including part 305 of Title 45, Code of Federal Regulations.
bodyHtml: [§576E-20]  Uniform statewide procedures.  The agency shall adopt uniform statewide procedures in compliance with applicable federal law, including part 305 of Title 45, Code of Federal Regulations. [L 1990, c 176, pt of §1]
